# UNIVERSE

> A local-first Windows desktop "digital brain": everything the owner has lives in one navigable 3D universe, run by a team of local AI agents. Electron + React UI, Python/FastAPI services, SQLite + LanceDB, local models via Ollama. Phases 0–4 are approved; Phase 5 (Forge + Sentinel, self-repair) is delivered and waiting for review; Phase 6 (Research, live web) is delivered.

Work on the branch `claude/phase-0-delivery-zuqlfx` (`main` holds an old, unrelated landing page). Read `AGENTS.md` first: it holds the binding rules (never edit the protected core, never weaken a test, never touch vault data, no secrets, network only through the egress gate) and is the single source of truth for every AI assistant.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): rules, commands, repository layout, current phase
- [docs/handoff/PROJECT-BRIEF.md](docs/handoff/PROJECT-BRIEF.md): everything about the project so far, in one document
- [docs/handoff/DECISIONS.md](docs/handoff/DECISIONS.md): every owner message and decision, verbatim
- [docs/HANDOFF.md](docs/HANDOFF.md): how any AI picks up the work, the start prompt, how to deliver a phase, getting the project to an AI

## Requirements and design

- [SPEC.md](SPEC.md): the owner's requirements; every line is one; §25 lists the phases and their "done when"
